# Nadia Hassan — Head of Data

- **Relationship:** Maya's direct report. Owns data engineering, the analytics platform, and ML
  infrastructure (~22 people). Joined Novaflow in 2023.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Tuesdays 16:00.
- **Owns:** [Cascade](../projects/cascade.md) — the data-pipeline re-architecture. Also the
  data-readiness workstream for [Falcon](../projects/falcon.md) diligence (confidential).
- **What she cares about:** data quality SLAs, pipeline cost, and not being an afterthought in
  platform decisions.

## How to work with her
- Rigorous and metrics-driven; she'll bring a dashboard to every disagreement.
- Advocate for her when platform work threatens data pipelines — she's easily deprioritized.
- She and Raj negotiate shared infra; Maya arbitrates when they deadlock.

## Sensitivities
- Wary of the Cascade vendor lock-in; wants an exit clause before Maya signs the contract.
